create.name: Rebecca Dawson
create.bio:
Rebecca Dawson is an Australian channel, author and teacher who has worked with channelled material for more than thirty years. She began speaking as a channel at the age of eighteen, and her teachings are presented as coming from a group she calls the Masters, among them Serapis Bey, St Germain and Kuthumi. Her themes include the shift in human consciousness, the nature of time and dimensional reality, purpose and conscious creation.

She is the author of four books, The New Human Experience, The Game of Purpose, The Agreement and Fu: The Return of the Magnetic Human. She teaches mainly online through livestream series, recorded seminars with transcripts, a monthly membership with live question-and-answer sessions and wisdom circles, and occasional in-person retreats and expo appearances. She also offers private channelled sessions over Zoom, has contributed articles to the Sedona Journal of Emergence, and has been a guest on many podcasts. In 2026 she taught a seven-week live course on perception on The Shift Network.

books.title: The New Human Experience
books.author: Rebecca Dawson
books.description: An exploration of the paradigm shift Rebecca describes as humanity's move into a new dimension of awareness: what the New Earth is, how the chakras and human capacities are changing, and how to rediscover yourself in the new energy.

books.title: The Game of Purpose: Discovering the Key to Freedom
books.author: Rebecca Dawson
books.description: A short book on the question of life purpose, inviting readers to look beyond old identities and the search for a single purpose towards a fuller sense of who they are.

books.title: The Agreement
books.author: Rebecca Dawson
books.description: Channelled wisdom about the inner sense of Source that many people are awakening to, and how to express it in daily life without depending on belief systems or ritual.

books.title: Fu - The Return of the Magnetic Human
books.author: Rebecca Dawson
books.description: A channelled message from the Masters about Fu, presented as a principle of natural law and the magnetic design of humanity, and about returning to inherent capacity as humanity expands in consciousness.

courses.title: Community Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership with a live channelled question-and-answer session, a channelled audio meditation, community wisdom circles and a library of ten years of recordings, transcripts and articles.

courses.title: The Art of Cosmic Travel
courses.description: A four-part recorded series with the Masters on sensing, navigating and tuning frequencies, presented as activating a dormant seventh sense.

courses.title: Biological Time Series
courses.description: A four-part video series exploring the relationship between time and human design, how timelines are created and the meaning of alchemy.

courses.title: The Zero Code
courses.description: Recordings from a four-week channelled intensive on numbers and creation: twenty audio tracks including three meditations, with a 116-page eBook transcript.

courses.title: The New Human Reality Masterclass
courses.description: A four-week channelled masterclass recorded in Perth, available as ten audio recordings with three guided meditations and a 100-page eBook.

courses.title: The Origin Journey
courses.description: Twenty channelled messages recorded on location in Indonesia during a group journey, with transcripts, exploring galactic origins and personal story.

courses.title: Remembering Your Mastery
courses.description: A recorded four-part group intensive with channelled guidance and practical exercises for reclaiming your own wisdom and bringing it into daily life.

courses.title: Remembering Your Mastery 2
courses.description: The follow-on four-part intensive, combining theory and practice around your capacity to create new realities.

courses.title: Totality: Closing the Loop
courses.description: A recorded workshop from Perth with channelled teaching, guided meditations and exercises about completing old patterns and moving into new possibilities.

courses.title: Mastering Money – The Law of Availability
courses.description: A recorded live channelled seminar on how the principles of manifestation and abundance are changing, and on our relationship with money.

free_resources.title: Playing with Time
free_resources.description: A free recording of a channelled seminar of almost two hours on timelines and living as a multidimensional human, with Serapis Bey and St Germain.

free_resources.title: Free book download
free_resources.description: A free download from one of her books (the site says a free book or chapter), sent by email after signing up on her home page.

flags: Based in Perth, Australia (YouTube handle 'Au', seminars recorded in Perth), but teaches mainly online, so listed as worldwide with no city.

Her only Shift Network course, Shift the 'Gears' of Your Perception, began 8 Oct 2026 and is left out as a dated event; no other Shift course was found, so teaches_at rests on a course already under way.
The free book download on her home page is described on the site as 'our book' and 'a free chapter' in different places; which book it is was not confirmed.
Amazon editions found are paperback/Kindle; The Game of Purpose, The Agreement and Fu use Amazon ASINs (B0…), not ISBN-10s.
